commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Sunderland have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+8' A pass from Jenson Seelt (Sunderland) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka and the move breaks down.
90+7' Oliver Sonne (Burnley) commits a foul and Michael Salisbury immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Sunderland.

90+6' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close! The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.

90+5' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
90+4' Sunderland are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
90+2' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+1' It looks like Omar Alderete (Sunderland) saw red with that tackle. Michael Salisbury won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Burnley.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
88' 2 - 0 Josh Cullen passes to Jaidon Anthony (Burnley), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
86' Scott Parker has decided to substitute Lyle Foster and he is replaced by Zian Flemming (Burnley).
85' Trai Hume (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
84' Kyle Walker (Burnley) makes a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. Sunderland win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
83' Substitution. Joe Worrall (Burnley) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Maxime Esteve walks off.
83' Scott Parker has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) replacing Hannibal Mejbri.
81' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sunderland comes to nothing.
80' Habib Diarra goes off the pitch and Marc Guiu (Sunderland) comes on.
79' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Lyle Foster (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
76' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
75' Sunderland are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
75' Sunderland are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
74' Neat passing move from Sunderland in order to create new attacking opportunities.
71' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sunderland.
69' Substitution. Oliver Sonne (Burnley) on for Jacob Bruun Larsen.
69' Problems for Scott Parker as Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Josh Laurent replaces him.
67' Sunderland are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
65' Sunderland enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

63' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Simon Adingra will be replaced by Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland).
63' Chemsdine Talbi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Patrick Roberts (Sunderland).
60' Neat passing move from Burnley in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' A short pass finds Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
52' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
49' Referee Michael Salisbury points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Josh Cullen (Burnley) goes wild in celebration.
49' The Burnley players halt their celebrations as referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Jaidon Anthony plays a short, square pass into the path of Josh Cullen (Burnley), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Burnley seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45+1' Sunderland hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Martin Dubravka, who smothers the ball.
44' Sunderland are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

43' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
41' Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

38' Burnley players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. It's a throw-in for Sunderland.
37' Nice passing game by Burnley. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
36' Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. Burnley get a free kick.

35' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is out of play. Sunderland will have a throw-in.
34' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Lyle Foster (Burnley) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
32' The Burnley players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sunderland.
30' Sunderland seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' Sunderland control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
19' That's a clear yellow card. Simon Adingra (Sunderland) goes into the book.
19' The Lyle Foster (Burnley) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Michael Salisbury rules it out for a foul.

15' Close! Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
15' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Robin Roefs (Sunderland) leaps to collect the ball.
14' Michael Salisbury interrupts the game. One of the players from Sunderland won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Burnley in a dangerous position.
13' Great teamplay by Burnley as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

8' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes.

4' Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Martin Dubravka reacts superbly to deny him.
4' Foul! Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Sunderland earn a free kick.
